Its EEG signature shows elevated γ (+15.8 dB, sensitivity=2.4) and elevated β_h (+6.4 dB, sensitivity=2.4).
The γ activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with active eye movements (SEM 0% active) and tonic muscle tone.
This is conflicting with N3 physiology: missing: δ elevated, δ dominant, EMG atonic. Note: model primarily uses γ, atypical for N3.
